## Summary

**What it is:** A remediation study planner for nursing students—generates multi-day study plans from a list of missed topics, spreading reviews and recall checks to optimize learning.

**Rules to follow:**
- Standard library only; plain JSON files for storage (no database or external calls)
- All plan text must stay within **PN scope**: reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan—never assess/diagnose/prescribe/treat
- Never include actual question text from paid qbanks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, etc.)—topic tags and own notes only
- Keep it local and private; no GitHub, no distribution, no network access
- Keep 7 as the default day count
